{"reason": "All 8 shown misses are truth=demand-forecast-error labeled unknown: 5 rows have market-mismatch=#t with no other signal, 3 have forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 below the 0.1 cutoff. I add market-signal-mismatch? to the forecast-error branch and lower the bias threshold to 0.06, converting unknowns into recoverable forecast-error claims.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
